content:
- Model consistently underestimates prices in the early part of the 30-day horizon, especially after recent spikes.
- Overestimates prices in the middle to late horizon, particularly after sharp upward moves.
- Shows persistent lag in responding to recent price drops — forecasts remain high longer than actuals.
- Tends to overshoot after sharp price spikes, then fails to correct downward quickly.
- Mean reversion is underemphasized — model holds onto high forecasts longer than actuals revert.
- Overconfident in short-term momentum; fails to account for volatility decay or policy-induced corrections.
- Underestimates downward pressure in the final 5–10 days of the forecast horizon, especially after prior peaks.
- Sensitive to recent history — overweights recent high prices in forecasts, leading to overestimation of future highs.
